sections.eyebrow: One Click™ to a Recorded Result
sections.title: One Click™ to a Recorded Result
sections.description: Learn what video capture actually adds to melting point determination on the Mettler Toledo MP30.
body: Traditional melting point determination relies on an operator watching a capillary and noting when melting starts and ends, a process that's inherently subjective and hard to verify after the fact. MP30 records a color video of the transition automatically, so the actual melt is captured and stored, not just summarized as a number.

That matters for two reasons: a stored video gives a second reviewer something concrete to check a borderline result against, and it gives a lab a genuine record of what was observed, not just what was concluded. Combined with 4 One Clicks™ that streamline the operational steps, MP30 turns a subjective, manual process into a documented, repeatable one.
